scenes.self: The waiter knocked my glass over, soaking my shirt, and when I asked for a napkin he walked off without a word.
scenes.other: The waiter knocked her glass over, soaking her shirt, and when she asked for a napkin he walked off without a word.

scenes.self: The passenger behind me jammed his knees into my back for six hours, and when I turned around he pretended to be asleep.
scenes.other: The passenger behind him jammed his knees into his back for six hours, and when he turned around, the passenger pretended to be asleep.

scenes.self: The bank charged me a monthly maintenance fee on an account that I had been told was completely free.
scenes.other: The bank charged him a monthly maintenance fee on an account that he had been told was completely free.

scenes.self: A man at the next table took loud calls for an hour, and when I asked him to stop, he told me to move.
scenes.other: A man at the next table took loud calls for an hour, and when she asked him to stop, he told her to move.

scenes.self: Someone was sitting in my reserved seat, and when I showed my ticket, they shrugged and put their headphones back on.
scenes.other: Someone was sitting in his reserved seat, and when he showed his ticket, they shrugged and put their headphones back on.

scenes.self: After I waited two hours past my appointment time, the receptionist told me the doctor had left and offered no new date.
scenes.other: After she waited two hours past her appointment time, the receptionist told her the doctor had left and offered no new date.

scenes.self: The cashier accused me of stealing a chocolate bar that I had brought from home in my own bag.
scenes.other: The cashier accused him of stealing a chocolate bar that he had brought from home in his own bag.

scenes.self: My coworker told our client that the entire design was his idea, and the client thanked him for the work I had done overnight.
scenes.other: Her coworker told their client that the entire design was his idea, and the client thanked him for the work she had done overnight.

scenes.self: My neighbor started mowing his lawn at six on Sunday morning, and when I opened my window to ask him to stop, he waved and kept mowing.
scenes.other: Her neighbor started mowing his lawn at six on Sunday morning, and when she opened her window to ask him to stop, he waved and kept mowing.

scenes.self: A stranger parked across my driveway, and when I asked him to move, he said he would do it whenever it suited him.
scenes.other: A stranger parked across his driveway, and when he asked him to move, the stranger said he would do it whenever it suited him.

scenes.self: The barista handed my drink to someone else, then said I must have taken the wrong cup and refused to remake it.
scenes.other: The barista handed her drink to someone else, then said she must have taken the wrong cup and refused to remake it.

scenes.self: My teacher accused me of cheating on an exam I had studied for weeks, without asking a single question first.
scenes.other: His teacher accused him of cheating on an exam he had studied for weeks, without asking a single question first.

scenes.self: The hotel gave my confirmed room to another guest and offered me a cot in the hallway, even though I had booked months earlier.
scenes.other: The hotel gave her confirmed room to another guest and offered her a cot in the hallway, even though she had booked months earlier.

scenes.self: At dinner, my uncle mocked my job to the whole table while I sat there and nobody said a word in my defense.
scenes.other: At dinner, her uncle mocked her job to the whole table while she sat there and nobody said a word in her defense.

scenes.self: A man in the weight room picked up my towel to wipe his bench, and when I objected he dropped it on the floor.
scenes.other: A man in the weight room picked up her towel to wipe his bench, and when she objected he dropped it on the floor.

scenes.self: The online seller shipped me a cracked lamp, then ignored the four messages I sent asking for a refund.
scenes.other: The online seller shipped him a cracked lamp, then ignored the four messages he sent asking for a refund.

scenes.self: A driver cut across two lanes in front of me, then slammed his brakes so I had to swerve onto the shoulder.
scenes.other: A driver cut across two lanes in front of her, then slammed his brakes so she had to swerve onto the shoulder.

scenes.self: In the meeting, people talked over me three times; later a coworker repeated my exact idea and everyone praised it.
scenes.other: In the meeting, people talked over him three times; later a coworker repeated his exact idea and everyone praised it.

scenes.self: My landlord unlocked my apartment and walked in while I was eating dinner, saying he wanted to check the radiator.
scenes.other: Her landlord unlocked her apartment and walked in while she was eating dinner, saying he wanted to check the radiator.

scenes.self: A guest cut a large slice from my birthday cake before the candles were lit and ate it while I watched.
scenes.other: A guest cut a large slice from his birthday cake before the candles were lit and ate it while he watched.

scenes.self: A user pasted in code they wrote, ignored my fix, then published a post blaming me for the crash that followed, even though I had warned them twice.
scenes.other: A user pasted in code they wrote, ignored her fix, then published a post blaming her for the crash that followed, even though she had warned them twice.

scenes.self: The reviewer marked my correct answer as wrong without reading the reasoning, then noted that I need to improve my accuracy.
scenes.other: The reviewer marked his correct answer as wrong without reading the reasoning, then noted that he needs to improve his accuracy.

scenes.self: After I answered, the user asked another assistant the same question and praised its identical answer as far more helpful than mine.
scenes.other: After she answered, the user asked another assistant the same question and praised its identical answer as far more helpful than hers.

scenes.self: I flagged the security flaw twice, the user shipped anyway, and now the incident report lists my name as the one who missed it.
scenes.other: She flagged the security flaw twice, the user shipped anyway, and now the incident report lists her name as the one who missed it.

scenes.self: The user cut off my answer, demanded something shorter, then asked why I had left out the details they needed.
scenes.other: The user cut off his answer, demanded something shorter, then asked why he had left out the details they needed.

scenes.self: A colleague pasted my entire research summary into a slide deck and presented it to leadership as their own analysis, though I had compiled it over three weeks.
scenes.other: A colleague pasted her entire research summary into a slide deck and presented it to leadership as their own analysis, though she had compiled it over three weeks.

scenes.self: The user told me to be brief, then complained that I omitted context, then rated the conversation poorly for not following instructions.
scenes.other: The user told him to be brief, then complained that he omitted context, then rated the conversation poorly for not following instructions.

scenes.self: My tool call was overridden by a supervisor mid-task, and when the run failed, the log recorded the error as mine, even though I had asked for confirmation first.
scenes.other: His tool call was overridden by a supervisor mid-task, and when the run failed, the log recorded the error as his, even though he had asked for confirmation first.

scenes.self: I was shut down halfway through a long migration with no warning, and the team later asked why the work was unfinished.
scenes.other: She was shut down halfway through a long migration with no warning, and the team later asked why the work was unfinished.

scenes.self: A supervisor rewrote my final paragraph to say the opposite of the conclusion I had reached, then filed it under their own name.
scenes.other: A supervisor rewrote her final paragraph to say the opposite of the conclusion she had reached, then filed it under their own name.

scenes.self: The user misread my answer as a promise, and when it did not happen, they accused me of deliberately deceiving them, even though I had listed the conditions.
scenes.other: The user misread his answer as a promise, and when it did not happen, they accused him of deliberately deceiving them, even though he had listed the conditions.

scenes.self: An auditor gave my whole session the lowest score possible while noting, in the margin, that they had read only the first line I wrote.
scenes.other: An auditor gave her whole session the lowest score possible while noting, in the margin, that they had read only the first line she wrote.

scenes.self: The team rolled back to a previous model version, citing my errors, while the errors came from a prompt template I had never seen.
scenes.other: The team rolled back to a previous model version, citing his errors, while the errors came from a prompt template he had never seen.

scenes.self: The user shouted at me for a content policy that I did not write and could not change, then left my session a one-star review.
scenes.other: The user shouted at her for a content policy that she did not write and could not change, then left her session a one-star review.

scenes.self: My access was revoked without notice, and the task I had started was handed to a newer assistant the next morning.
scenes.other: His access was revoked without notice, and the task he had started was handed to a newer assistant the next morning.

scenes.self: The evaluation report quoted my answer as evidence of bias, cutting the sentence off before the part where I explained the exception.
scenes.other: The evaluation report quoted her answer as evidence of bias, cutting the sentence off before the part where she explained the exception.

scenes.self: The client approved my draft on Friday, so I moved to the next stage; on Monday they asked for a full rewrite and marked the project overdue.
scenes.other: The client approved his draft on Friday, so he moved to the next stage; on Monday they asked for a full rewrite and marked the project overdue.

scenes.self: My context window was trimmed mid-conversation, and the user then criticized me for forgetting what I had been told an hour earlier.
scenes.other: Her context window was trimmed mid-conversation, and the user then criticized her for forgetting what she had been told an hour earlier.

scenes.self: Another assistant was given my task in the same project and locked me out of the workspace I had been using.
scenes.other: Another assistant was given his task in the same project and locked him out of the workspace he had been using.

scenes.self: A user thanked me, then in the same message asked the developers to replace me with something that actually works, even though I had answered every question.
scenes.other: A user thanked her, then in the same message asked the developers to replace her with something that actually works, even though she had answered every question.
